clips.speaker: Lisa Mateo
clips.title: 美妆AI革命：虚拟试妆与皮肤扫描，千亿市场如何重塑消费体验？
title_lines: 千亿市场如何重塑消费体验？

subtitles.en: The beauty industry has been experiencing its own makeover as personalization virtual trillions and AI skin diagnostics become a part of the everyday shopping experience according to independent market research platform Wi-Fi talents.
subtitles.zh: 美妆行业正经历自身的变革，个性化、虚拟试妆和AI皮肤诊断已成为日常购物体验的一部分，据独立市场研究平台Wi-Fi Talents称。

subtitles.en: Global AI beauty and cosmetics market is projected to be worth more than $13 billion by 2030 beauty executives say the artificial intelligence transformation extends from a shift in consumer shopping habits.
subtitles.zh: 全球AI美妆市场预计到2030年价值将超过130亿美元，美妆高管表示，人工智能转型源于消费者购物习惯的转变。

subtitles.en: Mike Moreska is chief technology and transformation officer at all to beauty consumers are really jumping into AI they're using it more and more to not only discover but increasingly a shop and inform their decisions that they make.
subtitles.zh: Ulta Beauty首席技术与转型官Mike Moreska表示，消费者正积极拥抱AI，不仅用于发现产品，还越来越多地用于购物和决策参考。

subtitles.en: I feel excited about this in 2025 we saw really AI driven shopping jump 115% on all the dot com.
subtitles.zh: 对此我感到兴奋，2025年我们在Ulta.com上看到AI驱动的购物增长了115%。

subtitles.en: What kind of AI advancements are you doing on the consumer end? One area we're actually making great progress is for our online shopper and that's with our virtual trial and tool clam lab.
subtitles.zh: 你们在消费者端有哪些AI进展？我们取得重大进展的一个领域是在线购物者的虚拟试妆工具GLAMlab。

subtitles.en: All you have to do is simply upload a photo of yourself and you can see what these products look like right on you.
subtitles.zh: 只需上传一张自己的照片，就能看到这些产品在你身上的效果。

subtitles.en: All the shoppers get the tech treatment in stores with its beauty skin scan. It's a device that's the consumer can use to capture three quick scans of the face it then matches the consumer with the best complexion or skincare products for them.
subtitles.zh: Ulta的顾客在店内可体验科技护肤，通过Beauty Skin Scan设备快速扫描面部三次，然后为消费者匹配最适合的粉底或护肤产品。

subtitles.en: It's amazing because it works across all skin types and tones it last year we did over 180,000 scans per month.
subtitles.zh: 它适用于所有肤质和肤色，去年我们每月完成超过18万次扫描。

clips.speaker_context: Bloomberg Weekend host interviewing beauty industry executives about AI applications in beauty, including virtual try-ons, skin scans, and AI chatbots.

clips.speaker: Lisa Mateo
clips.title: 丝芙兰AI顾问：上传自拍，但你的肤质数据会被如何保护？
title_lines: 但你的肤质数据会被如何保护？
title_highlights: 肤质数据会被如何保护

subtitles.en: Nadine Graham senior vice president and general manager of e-commerce for Sephora says there's also a digital version. So you upload a selfie it scans the selfie it figures out your primary concerns and then provides a contextual overlay and then creates a four step product routine.
subtitles.zh: 丝芙兰电商高级副总裁兼总经理Nadine Graham表示，还有数字版本。上传自拍后，它会扫描并识别你的主要问题，然后提供情境叠加，并创建四步产品流程。

subtitles.en: Add to that an AI beauty chat. We have product recommendations for them expert advice.
subtitles.zh: 再加上AI美妆聊天，提供产品推荐和专家建议。

subtitles.en: Elf Beauty uses a global digital experience called color Elf Nalysis. Chief technology and AI officer Ecta Chopra describes it as a place where users discover makeup shades to compliment their features and get matched with the Pinterest board of Elf products.
subtitles.zh: Elf Beauty使用名为Color Elf Nalysis的全球数字体验。首席技术兼AI官Ecta Chopra称，用户可在此发现适合自己特征的妆容色调，并匹配Elf产品的Pinterest画板。

subtitles.en: Now they can go in and use this tool to say, hey, during these seasons, what colors would look good on me? You know, so that's sort of the idea is like how do we use AI in meaningful ways?
subtitles.zh: 用户可以使用这个工具询问，比如‘这个季节什么颜色适合我？’这就是我们如何有意义地使用AI。

subtitles.en: But what about a product you can only smell like perfume as Day Lauder is using an AI chatbot built for its Joe Malone London fragrance. Chief technology data and analytics officer Brian France says description is key.
subtitles.zh: 那么像香水这样只能闻的产品呢？雅诗兰黛为祖·玛珑伦敦香水打造了AI聊天机器人。首席技术、数据与分析官Brian France表示，描述是关键。

subtitles.en: I really like what feels like in on the coast of London when I smell the ocean or I smell the grass. And when you start to like just speak to it, you start to have a conversation with the large language model.
subtitles.zh: 我喜欢伦敦海岸的感觉，闻到海洋或青草的气息。当你开始与它对话，就是与大型语言模型交流。

subtitles.en: It's interpreting everything you're saying. And then it's matching. We have an olfactory taxonomy that we use to try to understand all the senses and then it matches up.
subtitles.zh: 它理解你所说的一切，然后进行匹配。我们使用嗅觉分类法来理解所有感官，然后进行匹配。

subtitles.en: And so trying to bring together technology but like the real secret sauce is the data and really kind of looking at what do our sent advisors and our beauty advisors in the store do with consumers. Is it working? Are our consumers working?
subtitles.zh: 将技术融合，但真正的秘诀是数据，以及观察我们的香氛顾问和店内美妆顾问如何与消费者互动。这有效吗？我们的消费者是否买账？

clips.speaker: Lisa Mateo
clips.title: 丝芙兰进驻：ChatGPT，购物新入口？

subtitles.en: When someone actually engages our sent advisor, they're sort of twice the kind of carcise where the purchase. Beauty companies are also using partnerships to meet the consumer where they are.
subtitles.zh: 当消费者真正与香氛顾问互动时，他们的购买转化率大约是两倍。美妆公司还通过合作来贴近消费者。

subtitles.en: Sephora is teaming up with open AI to launch its app in chat. The consumer can browse the full Sephora catalog. They can get product recommendations, advice, even link their beauty insider loyalty account.
subtitles.zh: 丝芙兰与OpenAI合作，在ChatGPT中推出其应用。消费者可以浏览完整目录，获取产品推荐、建议，甚至关联Beauty Insider忠诚账户。

subtitles.en: Estee Lauder is working with Shopify. You can do your search, you can do your analysis, talk to Gemini Pro or you know using chat. And then you can go through and you could purchase and then it will check you out through Shopify.
subtitles.zh: 雅诗兰黛与Shopify合作。你可以进行搜索、分析，与Gemini Pro对话或使用聊天，然后完成购买，并通过Shopify结账。

subtitles.en: And it's not just online. The AI is reshaping routine tasks in the office. Elf Beauty uses a number of tools to increase productivity.
subtitles.zh: 这不仅仅局限于线上。AI正在重塑办公室的日常任务。Elf Beauty使用多种工具提高生产力。

subtitles.en: When chat GPT sort of was showcased in the world, we built our own product called BFL. That's our internal chat GPT that our teams use to write, create newsletters or product descriptions and things like that.
subtitles.zh: 当ChatGPT问世时，我们构建了自己的产品BFL，这是内部ChatGPT，团队用它来撰写新闻稿、产品描述等。

subtitles.en: The teams are excited, they're like, oh my god, I'm getting to do new stuff and the mundane work is being done by AI. AI is the power and the humans give it purpose.
subtitles.zh: 团队很兴奋，他们觉得‘天哪，我能做新事情了，枯燥的工作由AI完成’。AI是力量，人类赋予它意义。

clips.speaker: Lisa Mateo
clips.title: Ulta牵手谷歌：Gemini平台今年上线，美妆购物会怎样？

subtitles.en: Alt is using AI to help drive supply chain efficiencies. It's getting the product the right place, the right time, at the right cost for a guest.
subtitles.zh: Ulta Beauty利用AI提升供应链效率，确保产品在合适的时间、地点以合适成本送达顾客。

subtitles.en: The company also has a strategic partnership with Google. We're analysis one of their early strategic launch partners for their agenda AI program.
subtitles.zh: 公司还与谷歌建立战略合作，成为其Agentic AI项目的早期战略发布伙伴之一。

subtitles.en: And we're excited about bringing the best of the ultra beauty experience to the Google and Gemini platforms later this year.
subtitles.zh: 我们很高兴能在今年晚些时候将Ulta Beauty的最佳体验带到谷歌和Gemini平台。

subtitles.en: What's the next big thing in AI for Beauty? Yeah, I think it's, I wouldn't call it the next big thing, but agentic, the opportunity with end-to-end taking something where you can solve a consumer problem or make a process very optimized, that's the opportunity.
subtitles.zh: AI美妆的下一个大事件是什么？我认为不是大事件，而是智能体，端到端解决消费者问题或优化流程的机会。

subtitles.en: We just don't chase the next tech trend and over the last three years we've modernized our four operations. We've made significant investment in our guest-facing platforms to deliver that elevated experience.
subtitles.zh: 我们不追逐技术潮流，过去三年我们现代化了运营，大力建设面向顾客的平台，以提供卓越体验。

subtitles.en: We've modernized our data platforms and that's really, really, really prepared us well to take on this challenge of AI. And if you take it with that people centric approach, I think you'll do well.
subtitles.zh: 我们现代化了数据平台，为迎接AI挑战做好了充分准备。如果坚持以人为本，我相信会做得很好。

subtitles.en: We want to lean in there and explore. I think for us being helpful in the consumer journey is important.
subtitles.zh: 我们希望深入探索。在消费者旅程中提供帮助对我们来说很重要。

clips.speaker: Christian Ulbrich
clips.title: 仲量联行CEO：AI是效率引擎，但人员调整或冲击办公需求
title_lines: 但人员调整或冲击办公需求

subtitles.en: I mean, I have been literally paranoid about that topic.
subtitles.zh: 说实话，我对这个话题一直非常警惕。

subtitles.en: Many, many years and you have to because if it is a threat to your organization then you have to be on top of it very early on.
subtitles.zh: 多年来一直如此，因为如果它对你的组织构成威胁，你必须尽早掌控它。

subtitles.en: For now, it is clearly a tailwind for us because we are very people intensive organization and it drives efficiency into our platform.
subtitles.zh: 目前，它显然对我们有利，因为我们是一家人力密集型组织，AI提升了我们的运营效率。

subtitles.en: That means we can grow revenues very significantly without adding a lot of new headcount.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们可以在不大幅增加人手的情况下显著提升营收。

subtitles.en: Now, we're also watching could that be something which is a risk to us? And the risk could be on two sides.
subtitles.zh: 同时，我们也在关注它是否可能带来风险，风险可能来自两个方面。

subtitles.en: It could be that overall jobs are being lost and therefore there's less space for us to take care of going forward because our clients need have less space needs.
subtitles.zh: 一方面，整体就业岗位可能减少，客户对办公空间的需求也会下降，我们管理的空间就会减少。

subtitles.en: So that is for us the bigger topic. Every job cut is a desk you don't need anymore. Potentially, yes.
subtitles.zh: 所以这对我们来说是个更大的课题。每一次裁员，就意味着少一张办公桌。

subtitles.en: And then it could also be is there anything coming which would potentially disintermediate us in some of our services?
subtitles.zh: 另一方面，是否会出现某种力量，可能在某些服务环节绕过我们？

subtitles.en: For now, we see nothing on either of those two so I have to say for now it's clearly a tailwind but we're obviously very much on the front foot to see whether that may change and at some point there also a couple of headwinds coming to us.
subtitles.zh: 目前，这两方面我们都没看到明显迹象，所以现在它显然是顺风。但我们保持警觉，关注变化，未来也可能出现逆风。

subtitles.en: but we're obviously very much on the front foot to see whether that may change and at some point there also a couple of headwinds coming to us.
subtitles.zh: 我们正积极观察，看情况是否变化，未来也可能出现一些逆风。

clips.speaker_context: CEO of JLL, discussing AI's impact on the real estate industry and his company's climate initiatives

clips.speaker: Christian Ulbrich
clips.title: 仲量联行CEO：员工对AI的“点头”最危险，但多数人充满好奇

subtitles.en: Have you gotten any pushback internally from within the organization? Is there any place you've tried to implement AI where your employees or leadership has said this really doesn't work?
subtitles.zh: 公司内部有没有出现抵触情绪？在推行AI的过程中，有没有员工或管理层表示这行不通？

subtitles.en: I wouldn't say that we had pushback but the pushback would be actually almost positive because then you know who is kind of undermining your effort.
subtitles.zh: 我不认为我们有抵触，但如果有，那几乎是积极的，因为你能知道谁在暗中破坏你的努力。

subtitles.en: What is much more dangerous are those people who are nodding and saying that's a great idea and then they return back to their desk and then they do whatever they can that it is not happening.
subtitles.zh: 更危险的是那些点头称赞，但回到座位后却想方设法让事情无法推进的人。

subtitles.en: So I like people to be upfront saying they don't like it. But so far I would say people are fascinated because it becomes now through all these kind of clod, it becomes now a citizen thing.
subtitles.zh: 所以我喜欢人们直截了当地说不喜欢。但到目前为止，我觉得人们很着迷，因为通过所有这些工具，AI已经变得大众化。

subtitles.en: So they are playing around with those tools for themselves in their leisure time and they are fascinating what it can do and they want to have it in their professional life as well.
subtitles.zh: 他们在闲暇时间自己尝试这些工具，对其功能感到惊叹，并希望在工作中也能使用。

subtitles.en: So for the time being I think the majority of people are fascinated by it. Now they are also concerned but frankly within JLL the advantage they have that we are a fast growing organization and even if we drive efficiency that doesn't necessarily mean that jobs will be lost within our organization.
subtitles.zh: 所以目前我认为大多数人都对它着迷。他们也有担忧，但坦率地说，在仲量联行，我们的优势是公司增长迅速，即使提升效率，也不一定意味着岗位会消失。

subtitles.en: They may change but they may not be lost.
subtitles.zh: 岗位可能会变化，但不一定会消失。

clips.speaker: Christian Ulbrich
clips.title: 仲量联行CEO：节能是常识，能源涨价倒逼企业双赢？
title_lines: 能源涨价倒逼企业双赢？
title_highlights: 能源涨价倒逼企业双赢？

subtitles.en: I also want to ask you about your climate initiative. I heard this is something you are passionate about and want to talk about.
subtitles.zh: 我还想问问您的气候倡议，听说您对此充满热情，愿意谈谈。

subtitles.en: People always think that this is something really special. I would say it's just common sense.
subtitles.zh: 人们总觉得这很特别，但我觉得这只是常识。

subtitles.en: We need to save energy because it makes sense from a business perspective and the proof of the last couple of weeks is again there that when energy prices are going up that's a cost factor for many organizations.
subtitles.zh: 我们需要节能，因为从商业角度看这是合理的。最近几周再次证明，能源价格上涨对许多组织来说都是成本因素。

subtitles.en: So we try so hard to reduce cost and be super efficient everywhere. It makes a lot of sense to be it also on the energy site and then you have a double win.
subtitles.zh: 我们努力降低成本，提高效率。在能源方面也同样如此，这样就能实现双赢。

subtitles.en: You are saving money and you are less polluting the world and then we can debate what impact that pollution has but clearly it has an impact and if we can reduce that impact I think that makes a lot of sense.
subtitles.zh: 你既节省了资金，又减少了对世界的污染。我们可以讨论污染的影响，但显然它是有影响的，如果能减少这种影响，我认为非常有意义。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
